invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破2250（基于ATR 19和-4.3%风险），或融资费率Z-score升至>50%（空头压力缓解），或日线趋势转熊（价格<SMA50 $2133）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 2250 (based on ATR 19 and -4.3% risk), or funding Z-score rises to >50% (short pressure eases), or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50 $2133).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破0.09（基于ATR 0.0009），或融资费率Z-score升至>0%（空头压力缓解），或日线趋势转熊（价格<SMA50 $0.09）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 0.09 (based on ATR 0.0009), or funding Z-score rises to >0% (short pressure eases), or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50 $0.09).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格突破2350（入场价上方），或融资费率Z-score降至<30%（多头压力缓解），或日线趋势转熊（价格<SMA50 $2138.93）且动量转强。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks above 2350 (above entry), or funding Z-score falls to <30% (long pressure eases), or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50 $2138.93) with strengthening momentum.
